newsitem.title: USA: Consumers Water gets $600,000 in rate hikes.
newsitem.headline: Consumers Water gets $600,000 in rate hikes.

text.p: Consumers Water Co said Friday that it has settled two rate proceedings, with new annual revenues awarded totaling $600,000.
The company also said that there are three cases pending with revenues requested of $6 million, and two more of its subsidiaries intend to file for rate increases totaling $2.3 million during 1997.
All pending and yet-to-be-filed cases are primarily associated with capital expenditures. One $1 million case should be resolved this year, with the rest settled in 1998, added the company.
Consumers provides water and wastewater services to 860,000 people in six states.
